settings.hero_desc: A 60 cm long scale model of a turbofan jet engine - the fan, compressor and turbine stages reproduced in detail, with the casing cut away to reveal the internals. A striking display and teaching piece for aerospace firms, museums and aviation enthusiasts.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your engine type, scale, branding and base
settings.s1_body: A jet engine is a masterpiece of engineering hidden inside a cowling. This model brings it into the open - the fan, compressor stages and turbine reproduced in detail, with the casing cut away so you can see how thrust is made. Built to scale from your reference, it's a commanding centrepiece for aerospace receptions, exhibitions, training rooms and collectors.
settings.case_body: Built as a cutaway display, this turbofan model let an aerospace team show how a jet engine works without a single slide - a head-turning centrepiece for the reception and a clear teaching aid for training and tours.
settings.case_quote: It stops everyone who walks past, and it explains how the engine works better than any diagram.
settings.prov_p: There's no better way to appreciate a jet engine than to see inside it. A detailed cutaway model turns hidden engineering into something people can study, point at and admire.
